app.title: StreetComplete on iOS is now in public beta
app.author: Snowly
app.description: An open‑source open‑street map editor for iOS, released to public beta.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and build the iOS app in Xcode
Run the app on a simulator, load a map area, and create a new POI
Verify that the POI syncs to the GitHub issue tracker via the backend API
Measure build time and app size
